## M3-T11-041
TITLE: Homogeneous symmetric SU ramification and interior-fresh normalization firewall
TYPE: EXACT_STRUCTURE / SAME_MEASURE_HOMOGENEOUS_ADAPTER / ANTI_LOOP_FIREWALL
STATUS: PROVED_EXACT


CLAIM:
Write the audited symmetric coordinates as S=s/t and u=a/b in lowest terms and set N_u=a^2+b^2.  The M3-T11-031 discriminant-square incidence homogenizes to


W^2=-N_u*Phi,


where


Phi
=
N_u*s^4
-16*a*b*s^3*t
+(44*a^2-4*b^2)*s^2*t^2
+48*a*b*s*t^3
-16*a^2*t^4.


There is an exact division identity


Phi
=
N_u*(s^4+44*s^2*t^2-16*t^4)
-16*b*t*(a*s^3+3*b*s^2*t-3*a*s*t^2-b*t^3).


At an oriented odd split prime p|N_u with a==rho*b and rho^2==-1,


a*s^3+3*b*s^2*t-3*a*s*t^2-b*t^3
==
b*rho*(s-rho*t)^3,


and


Res_a(Phi,a^2+b^2)
=
256*b^4*t^2*(s^2+t^2)^3.


For the M3-T11-040 fresh allocation, put c_p=v_p(C_u) and k_p=v_p(Q_S)=2*lambda-c_p for p^lambda||m_i. Then


Q_S | Phi,
M_rel^2*C_u | N_u,
M_rel^2 | W.


After normalization


N_*=N_u/(M_rel^2*C_u),
Phi_*=Phi/Q_S,
W_*=W/M_rel^2,


one has exactly


W_*^2=-N_*Phi_*.


If 0<c_p<2*lambda, then


v_p(Phi)=k_p,
p does not divide N_*Phi_*W_*.


Thus every interior fresh prime is fully exhausted by the already-consumed conductor allocation; residual fresh p-content can occur only at the extreme allocations c_p=0 or c_p=2*lambda.


On an interior prime the remaining unit condition is


chi_p(-rho*Pi_p)=+1,


where Pi_p=p^(4*lambda)*P is the p-adic unit normalization of P=v_1*v_2*v_3.


POPULATION:
Exact fixed-content/coefficient nondegenerate relative-fresh endpoint packet on the canonical symmetric (S,u) pushforward.


HEIGHT:
Exact physical R<=B retained.


DEPENDS_ON:
M3-T11-031,
M3-T11-035,
M3-T11-036,
M3-T11-039,
M3-T11-040.


NOVELTY:
This is not a coordinate rename of M3-T11-040.  It adds a new load-bearing homogeneous quartic identity, its exact Gaussian-norm resultant/triple-root degeneration, and an exact post-conductor primitivity theorem for every interior fresh prime.


IMPLIES:
The interior-prime valuation mechanism cannot be charged a second time as a local density saving after Q_S*C_u=M_rel^2 has been consumed.
Any fixed-power use of the residual interior character requires a same-measure global dispersion/correlation theorem.
Extreme allocation primes remain legitimate tail targets.
If p|N_u and p|Phi with p not dividing the S denominator, the resultant forces p|s^2+t^2.


DOES_NOT_IMPLY:
No fixed-power moving-support deficit.
No independence of residual characters.
No theorem for the two extreme allocation tails.
No P/M3 limit theorem.


NO_DOUBLE_CHARGE:
The factors Q_S and C_u are exactly the same M_rel^2 conductor allocation already recorded by M3-T11-040.  M3-T11-041 may use only the normalized residual equation W_*^2=-N_*Phi_*; the forced interior valuation itself supplies zero new credit.


ANTI_LOOP:
Even hypothetical independent one-half rejection at each distinct interior prime gives only 2^(-omega(M_int))=M_int^(-o(1)) uniformly, not a fixed power.  Do not open a naive local-character tensor route.

## M3-T11-042
TITLE: Collision-free fourth-power fresh denominator on the symmetric middle coefficient E
TYPE: EXACT_STRUCTURE / SAME_MEASURE_CONDUCTOR_RECOMBINATION / FIXED_FIBER_CANDIDATE
STATUS: PROVED_EXACT_WITH_OPEN_COUNTING_GATE


CLAIM:
For the corrected anti-roots v_i=A_i/B_i and symmetric middle coefficient
E=T_2/D,
with
D=B_1*B_2*B_3,
T_2=A_1*A_2*B_3+A_1*A_3*B_2+A_2*A_3*B_1,
every fresh prime p^lambda||m_i satisfies
v_p(Den(E))=4*lambda.
Hence exactly on the relative-fresh support
boxed:
M_rel^4 | Den(E),
and
gcd(Den(E),M_rel^infinity)=M_rel^4.


For the audited coordinates S=s/t and u=a/b, N_u=a^2+b^2,
boxed:
E=4*a*(b*s-a*t)/(t*N_u).
The M3-T11-040 fresh exponents
v_p(t)=2*lambda-c_p
and
min(4*lambda,v_p(N_u))=2*lambda+c_p
therefore recombine to the full baseline 4*lambda in one reduced rational coordinate.
The M_rel^4 denominator is not an additional saving; it is a collision-free repackaging of the already-consumed S/u conductor partition.


FIXED-E QUOTIENT:
For fixed e=E and u!=0,
S=[e+(e+4)u^2]/(4u).
With x=u^2 and Z=16*u^2*Y/(1+u^2), the split-cubic discriminant gives
Z^2=-F_e(x),
where
F_e(x)
=
(e+4)^4*x^4
+4*(e+4)^2*(e^2-12*e+112)*x^3
+2*e*(3*e^3-40*e^2-16*e+1280)*x^2
+4*e^2*(e^2-12*e-16)*x
+e^4.


Its discriminant is
-2^36*e^6*(e+4)^4*(3e-8)^3*(e^3-4e^2+4e+196).


The cubic factor has no rational root, so the only rational singular parameters are
e=0,-4,8/3.
They are absent on M_rel>1 because M_rel^4|Den(e) but their reduced denominators are 1,1,3.


Thus every physical large-M_rel fixed-E quotient is smooth genus one.
Over K=Q(i) it has explicit K-points at x=0, Z=+/-i*e^2 and at infinity, so it is elliptic over one fixed field after choosing an origin.


TORSION DIAGNOSTIC:
For the standard scaled Jacobian, exact symbolic factorization over Q(i)(e) leaves the 2-, 3-, and 5-division polynomials irreducible of degrees 3, 4, and 12 respectively.
Hence no generic rational-function torsion section of order 2, 3, or 5 is available.
This blocks a direct reuse of the M3-T11-036 low-prime-torsion/Dujella argument, but does not rule out every higher-prime mechanism.


POPULATION:
Exact fixed-content/coefficient nondegenerate relative-fresh endpoint packet.


HEIGHT:
Exact physical R<=B retained; E has polynomial height.


DEPENDS_ON:
M3-T11-031,
M3-T11-033,
M3-T11-040,
M3-T11-041.


IMPLIES:
For fixed realized E, compatible M_rel values are divisor-many.
A new parallel route is available through either a uniform fixed-E B^o(1) theorem plus active-E support deficit, or a direct same-measure fourth-power-denominator tail.


DOES_NOT_IMPLY:
No fixed-E B^o(1) theorem.
No active-E support deficit.
No independent density gain beyond M3-T11-040.
No P/M3 theorem.


NO_DOUBLE_CHARGE:
The M_rel^4 denominator is the single-coordinate recombination of the M3-T11-040 Q_S/C_u allocation and M3-T11-033 denominator carriers. Do not multiply its putative saving with Q_S or C_u without a new same-measure theorem.


ARSENAL_AUDIT:
AR-014 is only a fixed-outer common-gcd square-divisor fiber adapter and does not give a whole-family denominator-event deficit.
SR-STR-170 likewise leaves a same-measure square-divisor threshold-event theorem external.


FLAGS:
M3_T11_E_FULL_MREL4_DENOMINATOR=true
M3_T11_E_RECOMBINES_SU_FRESH_CONDUCTOR=true
M3_T11_E_FIXED_FIBER_GENUSONE_QUOTIENT=true
M3_T11_E_FIXED_FIBER_SINGULAR_LARGE_MREL_EMPTY=true

## M3-T11-042
TITLE: Exact common-u norm saturation inside the cubic denominator
TYPE: EXACT_STRUCTURE / INTEGER_NORMAL_FORM / ANTI_LOOP_FIREWALL
STATUS: PROVED_EXACT


CLAIM:
Write u=a/b reduced, N_u=a^2+b^2, g_u=gcd(4,N_u) in {1,2}, and retain S=T_1/D, E=T_2/D, P=T_3/D.


The canonical symmetric parameterization gives exactly


N_u*T_3=4*a^2*T_1,


N_u*T_2=4*a*b*T_1-4*a^2*D.


Hence


N_u/g_u | T_1


and, using the second identity,


boxed:
N_u/g_u | D.


Let d=gcd(T_1,T_3), epsilon=sign(T_1), and R_u=N_u/g_u.  Since M3-T11-035 gives R_u=|T_1|/d, there is an integer K>0 with


D=K*R_u,
T_1=epsilon*d*R_u,
S=epsilon*d/K,


and


T_3=epsilon*(4*d/g_u)*a^2,
T_2=(4/g_u)*(epsilon*a*b*d-a^2*K).


Thus


g_u*F_v(X)
=
N_u*K*X^3
-epsilon*d*N_u*X^2
+4*(epsilon*a*b*d-a^2*K)*X
-epsilon*4*a^2*d.


For every fresh p^lambda||m_i, p does not divide d*g_u and v_p(D)=4*lambda.  Combining S=epsilon*d/K with M3-T11-040 yields


v_p(K)=2*lambda-c_p,


and therefore the previous capped common-u norm valuation upgrades to


boxed:
v_p(N_u)=2*lambda+c_p


for every fresh prime, including c_p=2*lambda.


Consequently


boxed:
(N_u)_{M_rel-fresh}=M_rel^2*C_u,


and for N_*=N_u/(M_rel^2*C_u),


boxed:
gcd(N_*,M_rel)=1.


Combining with M3-T11-041 gives W_*^2=-N_*Phi_* with all residual fresh valuation carried by Phi_*, and v_p(Phi_*) even.


POPULATION:
Exact fixed-content/coefficient nondegenerate relative-fresh endpoint packet on the audited symmetric (S,u) coordinates.


HEIGHT:
Exact physical R<=B retained.


DEPENDS_ON:
M3-T11-031,
M3-T11-035,
M3-T11-033,
M3-T11-040,
M3-T11-041.


NOVELTY:
The divisor N_u/g_u|D and the resulting uncapped valuation v_p(N_u)=2*lambda+c_p were not present in the prior conductor-partition card.  This removes a genuine uncertainty at the extreme c_p=2*lambda boundary.


IMPLIES:
The C_u factor is the entire fresh common-u norm excess, not a capped proxy.
Fresh valuation v_p(N_u)>4*lambda is impossible.
The normalized factor N_* is coprime to all fresh conductor primes.
At an extreme amplified-u prime, any residual p-factor of Phi_* is even and, when present, lies on the S Gaussian root line from the M3-T11-041 resultant.


DOES_NOT_IMPLY:
No fixed-power extreme-tail theorem.
No global character dispersion theorem.
No P/M3 limit theorem.


NO_DOUBLE_CHARGE:
Since N_u/g_u is already an exact divisor of D, do not charge the amplified-u C_u condition and a separate divisor-density event N_u/g_u|D as independent savings.


ANTI_LOOP:
Do not search for fresh valuation beyond p^(4*lambda) in A_u^2+B_u^2.  M3-T11-042 proves this branch is saturated exactly at the M3-T11-040 cap.


FLAGS:
M3_T11_COMMON_U_NORM_OVER_G_DIVIDES_D=true
M3_T11_COMMON_U_INTEGER_NORMAL_FORM=true
M3_T11_FRESH_COMMON_U_NORM_VALUATION_EXACT=true
M3_T11_COMMON_U_NORM_FRESH_PART=MREL2_TIMES_CU

## M3-T11-043
TITLE: Amplified-u extreme residual elimination and denominator-extreme normalization
TYPE: EXACT_STRUCTURE / EXTREME_BRANCH_ELIMINATION / FIREWALL
STATUS: PROVED_EXACT
CLAIM:
On the canonical symmetric packet write S=s/t and u=a/b reduced, N_u=a^2+b^2, and for p^lambda||m_i set c_p=v_p(C_u), k_p=2*lambda-c_p.
The retained exact middle-coefficient identity
E=4*a*(b*s-a*t)/(t*N_u)
has v_p(Den(E))=4*lambda on every relative-fresh p.
The current exact saturation gives
v_p(N_u)=2*lambda+c_p
and
v_p(t)=k_p.


If c_p=2*lambda, then p does not divide t and v_p(N_u)=4*lambda.
Exact preservation of the p^(4*lambda) denominator of E forces
p not dividing (b*s-a*t).
If p divided Phi_*, then k_p=0 gives p|Phi; with rho=a*b^(-1) mod p and rho^2=-1, the exact triple-root identity
a*s^3+3*b*s^2*t-3*a*s*t^2-b*t^3
==
b*rho*(s-rho*t)^3 mod p
would force s==rho*t mod p, hence p|(b*s-a*t), contradiction.
Therefore
c_p=2*lambda => v_p(Phi_*)=0.


Together with M3-T11-041 for 0<c_p<2*lambda,
boxed:
c_p>0 => v_p(Phi_*)=0,
so
boxed:
gcd(Phi_*,C_u)=1.
All residual fresh Phi_* support is therefore confined to the full-S-denominator extreme c_p=0.


For c_p=0, n=2*lambda, write N_u=p^n*n_0 and t=p^n*t_0.
Modulo p after removing the forced p^n factor,
boxed:
p^(-n)*Phi == s^3*(n_0*s-16*a*b*t_0).
Hence residual p-divisibility requires
boxed:
n_0*s == 16*a*b*t_0 mod p,
and the normalized square forces the residual exponent to be even.


POPULATION:
Exact fixed-content/coefficient nondegenerate relative-fresh endpoint packet on the canonical symmetric (S,u) pushforward.
HEIGHT:
Exact physical R<=B retained.
DEPENDS_ON:
M3-T11-041;
retained Section-49 exact flag M3_T11_E_FULL_MREL4_DENOMINATOR=true;
current exact common-u saturation M3_T11_FRESH_COMMON_U_NORM_VALUATION_EXACT=true.
IMPLIES:
The amplified-u extreme is not a live residual valuation tail.
ExtremePhiResidualTail reduces to FullSDenominatorExtremeResidualTail.
Residual fresh Phi_* primes are disjoint from C_u support.
DOES_NOT_IMPLY:
No fixed-power estimate for c_p=0.
No independence or dispersion theorem for residual unit characters.
No P(B)/M3(B) limit theorem.
NO_DOUBLE_CHARGE:
The E denominator is used only to contradict same-orientation cancellation on c_p=2*lambda; it contributes no separate density saving.
ALIASES:
AmplifiedUExtremePhiResidualEmpty;
PhiStarCuCoprime;
FullSDenominatorExtremeResidualOnly.
DUPLICATE_OF:
NONE.
SUPERSEDES:
The part of the prior extreme-residual frontier that left c_p=2*lambda open.
DO_NOT_REPEAT:
Do not search for higher or residual fresh Phi_* valuation on c_p=2*lambda.
REOPEN_CONDITION:
Retract the exact E fourth-power denominator or the exact common-u fresh saturation; otherwise only a genuinely new non-valuation same-measure mechanism may revisit this branch.
DETAIL_DOC:
K16-C3-M3-ROUTE-TRIVIAL-SPLIT-CYCLE section 50.
ID_HYGIENE:
The existing research history already contains two entries labelled M3-T11-042. This card names its exact dependencies by formula/flag and does not renumber prior material.

## M3-T11-044
TITLE: Fixed-E physical square lift genus-3 Prym split and reciprocal-involution firewall
TYPE: EXACT_STRUCTURE / NEGATIVE_RESULT / FIREWALL
STATUS: PROVED_EXACT
CLAIM:
For the retained fixed-E quartic Z^2=-F_e(x), physicality imposes x=u^2.
The true square-x lift
C_e: Z^2=-F_e(u^2)
is a smooth genus-3 curve on every large-M_rel physical rational e.
Its involution u->-u has the existing elliptic quotient
E_e: Z^2=-F_e(x),
and the complementary involution (u,Z)->(-u,-Z) has the genus-2 quotient
H_e: V^2=-x*F_e(x).
Thus
Jac(C_e) is Q-isogenous to E_e x Jac(H_e).


For the even octic coefficients q4,q3,q2,q1,q0 of F_e(u^2), a Q-rational reciprocal commuting involution u->lambda/u would require
q0*q3^2-q4*q1^2=0.
Exact factorization gives
boxed:
q0*q3^2-q4*q1^2
=
4096*e^4*(e+4)^4*(e^2-12*e+48),
and
e^2-12*e+48=(e-6)^2+12.
Hence no nondegenerate rational e admits such a reciprocal involution.


POPULATION:
Physical large-M_rel fixed-E fibers from the symmetric Stage37 route.
HEIGHT:
Exact physical R<=B retained; this card proves geometry only, not a point count.
DEPENDS_ON:
The retained fixed-E quartic and exact E fourth-power denominator;
audited Stage25 R504 even-octic reciprocal criterion.
IMPLIES:
The direct reciprocal-second-elliptic-quotient route is uniformly closed.
The square-x lift leaves a genuine genus-2 Prym factor.
DOES_NOT_IMPLY:
No exclusion of exceptional non-bielliptic elliptic isogeny factors of Jac(H_e).
No fixed-E uniform B^o(1) point count.
No active-E support deficit.
No P(B)/M3(B) theorem.
ALIASES:
FixedESquareLiftGenus3;
FixedEPrymGenus2;
FixedEReciprocalSecondQuotientClosed.
DUPLICATE_OF:
NONE.
SUPERSEDES:
NONE.
DO_NOT_REPEAT:
Do not search for fixed-E uniformity by a generic Q-rational reciprocal involution u->lambda/u.
REOPEN_CONDITION:
An exact non-reciprocal elliptic factor with a compatible counting adapter, or a direct uniform genus-2/genus-3 counting theorem.
DETAIL_DOC:
K16-C3-M3-ROUTE-TRIVIAL-SPLIT-CYCLE section 51.
FLAGS:

M3_T11_FIXED_E_PRYM_GENUS2_QUOTIENT=true

## M3-T11-045
TITLE: Full-S-denominator Legendre x-coordinate and generic fixed-x cubic
TYPE: EXACT_STRUCTURE / SAME_MEASURE_LOCAL-TO-GLOBAL_ADAPTER / THEOREM-GATE_REFINEMENT / FIREWALL
STATUS: PROVED_EXACT_WITH_PROVISIONAL_COUNTING_ADAPTER


CLAIM:
On the canonical symmetric packet put
S=s/t,
u=a/b,
N=1+u^2,
and on a remaining full-S-denominator fresh prime p^lambda||m_i with c_p=0 put n=2*lambda.
Then
v_p(N)=v_p(t)=n.
Define
T=N*S,
delta=T-16u,
and
boxed:
x=T/(16u)=((1+u^2)S)/(16u)=(a^2+b^2)*s/(16*a*b*t).


Exact algebra gives
boxed:
N^3*Q(S,u)=delta*T^3-4*N*H(delta,u),
with
H(delta,u)
=
-11*delta^2*u^2+delta^2
-364*delta*u^3+20*delta*u
+4*u^6-3000*u^4+68*u^2.


Since Y^2=-NQ,
boxed:
(NY)^2=-delta*T^3+4*N*H.
Modulo p^n this yields, after division by the square p-unit (16uT)^2,
boxed:
r^2 == x*(1-x) mod p^n,
r=NY/(16uT).


If
M_0=product p^lambda
over all c_p=0 fresh prime powers, CRT gives
boxed:
r^2 == x*(1-x) mod M_0^2.


Also, using Q=Phi/(t^4*b^2),
boxed:
min(v_p(Phi_*),n)=min(v_p(x-1),n).
Thus the M3-T11-043 normalized collision is exactly x==1 mod p; below saturation the residual exponent equals v_p(x-1) and is even.


For fixed rational x, substituting delta=16u(x-1), v=u^2 and R_x=NY/(4u) gives
boxed:
R_x^2=P_x(v),
where
P_x(v)
=
v^3
+(3-48*x-704*x^2)*v^2
+(3-96*x-640*x^2+4096*x^3-4096*x^4)*v
+(1-48*x+64*x^2).


Its discriminant is
boxed:
2^24*x^8*(8*x+1)*(40*x-27)^3.
Hence every rational fixed-x fiber outside
x in {0,-1/8,27/40}
is a smooth elliptic cubic.


Its 3-division polynomial contains the factor
3*v+64*x^2-48*x+3.
At
v_0=-(64*x^2-48*x+3)/3,
boxed:
P_x(v_0)=-4096*x^4*(40*x-27)^2/27.
Therefore every smooth fixed-x fiber has an explicit exact order-3 point over the one fixed field K=Q(sqrt(-3)):
boxed:
(v_0,R_0)
=
(
 -(64*x^2-48*x+3)/3,
